description: Implementation of a mutable connection logger that can be muted and unmuted, responsible for logging connection-related events and maintaining logs. This class manages the logging state and delegates logging actions to an underlying delegate.

classes.name: DefaultMuteableConnectionLogger
classes.description: A mutable implementation of a connection logger that can be muted or unmuted, controlling whether logs are forwarded to the delegate.

methods.name: DefaultMuteableConnectionLogger
methods.description: Constructor initializing the logger with a connection ID and a delegate, starts in muted state.

methods.name: mute
methods.description: Mute the logger, preventing logs from being forwarded.

methods.name: unmute
methods.description: Unmute the logger, allowing logs to be forwarded.

methods.name: isMuted
methods.description: Check if the logger is currently muted.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Log a success event if unmuted.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Log a success event with message and arguments if unmuted.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Log a failure event with an exception if unmuted.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Log a failure event with message and arguments if unmuted.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Log an exception event if unmuted.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Log an exception with message and arguments if unmuted.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clear the logs in the delegate.

methods.name: getLogs
methods.description: Retrieve logs if unmuted; otherwise, return an empty list.

methods.name: logTrace
methods.description: Internal method to log a trace message with connection ID context.

methods.name: logTraceWithCorrelationId
methods.description: Internal method to log a trace message with correlation and connection IDs.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Override to compare connection logger instances.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Override to generate a hash code for the logger.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Override to generate a string representation of the logger.
